answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: synchronized liveness challenges. At random moments the network issues a fresh interactive puzzle to every identity at once and demands a quick echo back within a tight window. One controller running a thousand fakes must answer a thousand distinct live prompts simultaneously, a bottleneck that cannot be precomputed or queued. Honest agents each reply from their own ledge of context like a solid timber beam bearing its own load. Faking breadth in real time costs as much as operating that many genuinely separate agents, so the sybil shortcut collapses.
